android: Sign in with Google now works inside the app: it opens a secure Google sign-in tab and comes straight back. You stay signed in after closing the app.
The app now tells you when a new version is out, with what's new and an Update button.
Lock-screen and headphone pause always pauses (it could restart the station instead).
Lock-screen skip buttons change to the next or previous station.
ios: Sign in with Google now works inside the app: it opens Apple's secure sign-in sheet and comes straight back. You stay signed in after closing the app.
The radio pauses for phone and WhatsApp calls and comes back on by itself when the call ends.
Lock-screen pause always pauses (it could restart the station over a call).
Lock-screen "10 s" arrows change to the next or previous station.
